patch_description: Implement a recency boost mechanism that temporarily amplifies access_count for recently-accessed folios. When a folio is accessed within a tight recency window (50ms), boost its access_count by 2 instead of 1. This creates a "spike" in the frequency signal that better protects working-set folios during bursty network access patterns. The boost decays faster (by 2 per decay cycle instead of 1) to avoid long-term memory waste. This synergizes with the existing frequency decay mechanism to improve cache hit rates during active sessions while maintaining natural decay during idle periods.
